manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Two balls side by side: one tossed up, one released from rest at the top. Both then fall together.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: The Toss lane shows a ball thrown upward. The Drop lane holds a second ball at the top height until the gate opens. Velocity and acceleration arrows show both balls.
